relationships.subject: HO-1 inducer 1m
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased levels of NLRP3 incited by CCI (F (5,12) = 4.41, p < 0.016; vs. SHAM-VEH; Figure 4A) were normalized with the administration of each of these treatments

relationships.subject: HO-1 inducer 1m
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of Nrf2 (F (5,12) = 16.19, p < 0.001; Figure 4B), HO-1 (F (5,12) = 15.19, p < 0.001; Figure 4C), and SOD-1 (F (5,12) = 12.26, p < 0.002; Figure 4E) was significantly increased in animals treated with 1m, 1b, 1a, or DMF

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: The Nrf2 transcription factor may also attenuate the expression of NF-κB, resulting in a negative regulation of the NLRP3 inflammasome activity

key_findings: Oral HO-1 inducers 1m, 1b and DMF reversed CCI allodynia and hyperalgesia and anxiodepressive behaviors; 1m was most effective.
All compounds normalized elevated NLRP3 and raised Nrf2, HO-1 and SOD-1 in DRG and amygdala.
